render_rotation_camera: render a sequence of images by rotating the camera along the u-axis across n_steps
render_rotation_camera3: render 36 images with a camera orbiting in both pitch and yaw around the subject
render_rotation_both: render images with camera rotation and concatenate depth and normal maps alongside each output
render_rotation_grid: render images from a grid of camera positions using spherical coordinate sampling
render_rotation_camera_grid: render images across 3 vertical camera angles with 60 horizontal rotation steps each
